title: Lux node info
description: What a Lux node tells anyone who asks: what it is running, what network it is on, who it is connected to, and what its chains cost.

ops.description:
NodeVersion is what this node is running: its own release, the database format
it reads, and the VM protocol it speaks.

Identity is this node's id, with the proof it holds the staking key that id is
derived from.
Address is where this node tells its peers to reach it.
NetworkID is the number of the network this node is on.
NetworkName is the name of the network this node is on.
ChainID resolves a chain's alias to the id it names.
Bootstrapped reports whether a chain has finished bootstrapping on this node.

Chains are the chains this node is running, which is a subset of the chains
the P-Chain knows about.

Peers are the nodes this one is connected to. A list of node ids narrows the
answer to those, and no list asks for all of them.
LPs is where the network's stake stands on every current Lux Proposal.

VMs are the virtual machines installed on this node, and the feature
extensions its UTXO chains understand.
Upgrades is the upgrade schedule this node runs.
Uptime is how much of the network, by stake, reports having seen this node up.
Fees are the transaction fees this node charges, in nLUX.

fields.name: bootstrapped

fields.name: chains
fields.doc: Chains are the chains this node is running.

fields.name: tx_fee

fields.name: create_asset_tx_fee

fields.name: create_chain_tx_fee

types.name: LP
types.doc: LP is where the stake stands on one proposal.

fields.name: support_weight

fields.name: network_id

types.name: NetworkName

types.doc: NodeID is this node's id, with the proof it holds the staking key.

fields.name: node_pop

fields.name: ip

types.name: NodeVersion
types.doc: NodeVersion is what this node is running.

fields.doc: DatabaseVersion is the database format this node reads.

fields.doc: RPCProtocolVersion is the VM protocol this node speaks.

fields.name: git_commit

types.doc: Peer is one connection this node holds.

fields.name: node_id

fields.doc: Version is the release the peer is running.

fields.name: observed_uptime
fields.doc: ObservedUptime is the share of time this node has seen the peer up.

fields.name: tracked_chains
fields.doc: TrackedChains are the chains the peer is following.

types.name: Peers
types.doc: Peers are the nodes this one is connected to.

fields.name: num_peers
fields.doc: NumPeers is how many connections this node holds.

fields.name: peers
fields.doc: Peers are the connections themselves.

fields.name: node_ids

types.name: Upgrades

fields.doc: StopVertexID is the vertex the linearisation stopped at.

fields.name: epoch_duration

types.name: Uptime

fields.name: fxs
fields.doc: Fxs are the feature extensions the UTXO chains understand, by id.
